The 30 September digest gives the number as #8841. Mateo Quiroga submitted it for Vantorre Group, covering Dock Door 14 at Newark not appearing on the check-in kiosk, and Gideon escalated it to platform engineering.

Check it before you send it on. Earlier digests use the same number for a different issue: the 5/4 digest has #8841 for an Allentown Door 12 kiosk timeout, and the 4/27 digest has PD-8841 for missed check-ins at Allentown. There is also no ticket file for Vantorre Group in the share to confirm it.
